dct_description_sm: Abstract: Orchard area features for Israel. Feature vector data was extracted by East View Cartographic from 1:500,000 series Soviet military topographic source map sheets published in 1987.

Purpose: These data are intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production.
